import json
def snap(f):
    seg=f.segmentation
    out={}
    for n in seg['nodes']:

        b=n['boundary']
        r0=min(p[0] for p in b); c0=min(p[1] for p in b)
        out[(n['color'],r0,c0)]=n['pixels']
    return out
